## Invitations

A total of 1852 invitations were issued during the outreach activity. Of those invited, 726 people attended. This represents an attendance rate of 39.2 per cent. The result provides a clear measure of engagement with the invitation process and will support ongoing review of outreach activity.

The attendance outcome should be considered alongside the methods used to contact invitees. The figures indicate that a substantial number of people received an invitation, while attendance remained below the total number invited. Further monitoring will help identify opportunities to improve participation and support access to services.

## Contact

SMS was the primary recorded contact method, reaching 1586 invitees. No reminders were recorded, with the reminder total reported as 0. The contact figures will be used to inform future communication planning and to consider whether additional follow-up is required.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
